title: Wheel Command V2.0
description: A Data Type representing a steering command directed to a specific wheel of the Connected Autonomous Vehicle.

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Wheel Command instance.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Wheel Command instance.

WheelCommandID.description: Unique identifier of this Wheel Command instance.

WheelID.description: Identifier of the wheel being commanded.

WheelCommandTime.description: Time this Wheel Command instance was produced.

Angle.description: Desired steering angle in degrees (–90 to +90).

SteeringMode.description: Steering mode: one of ManualAssist, SteerByWire, ActiveSteering, EmergencyOverride, Calibration.

SteeringRateLimit.description: Maximum allowed steering rate in degrees per second.

Phase.description: Phase of the steering envelope: one of ramp-up, hold, ramp-down.

Angle.description: Target steering angle for this phase in degrees.

SteeringRate.description: Steering rate for this phase in degrees per second.

SafetyLimits.description: Safety constraints for the steering actuator.

MechanicalStopWarning.description: Indicates proximity to the mechanical steering stop.

HealthAwareness.description: Health and condition information of the steering actuator.

ThermalDerating.description: Indicates whether thermal derating is active.

LoadEstimate.description: Estimated load on the steering actuator.

CalibrationRequired.description: Indicates whether calibration of the steering actuator is required.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Wheel Command instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Wheel Command instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
